notes.title: 1.1.0 - Enhanced Gameplay Logic & Event System Overhaul
notes.content: [p]Hello Pongers![/p][p]After some feedback we got this update.[/p][p]This update brings major performance improvements and gameplay tweaks. Core scripts like the player, pause, and main menu have been optimized for smoother and faster operation.[/p][p]We've added a clear visual effect to show which player or enemy is using a skill. New dynamic random events, including a "bounce" event, make gameplay more exciting, while event timing has been adjusted to be less disruptive. A progress bar now shows when the next event will trigger.[/p][p]Power-ups have been removed to focus the experience, and several bugs have been fixed—such as skill issues, ball trail visibility, and crashes related to language or fullscreen settings.[/p][p]With this update, we're taking a break from PongBall development to explore a new project. Unless any critical bugs appear, there won’t be new updates for a while.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting PongBall![/p][p][/p][p][b]WE STILL NEED FEEDBACK![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]✨ NEW:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added use skill effect to both player and enemy to indicate who is using a skill[/p][/*][*][p]Added new random event: [b]"bounce"[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic random events[/p][/*][*][p]Added progress bar when the next event starts[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔨 IMPROVEMENT:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized player script[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized pause script to be fully functional[/p][/*][*][p]Increased range time of random events to make them less disruptive[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased bounce angle of the ball[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Tournament_draw logic[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized main menu script for faster startup loading[/p][/*][*][p]Improved loading of audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized game start sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized choose_mode logic[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 FIX:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the "no goal" skill was not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with null value when loading fullscreen settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed language-related crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where ball trail didn’t appear after using the invisible ball[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue in the random_bounce event[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.0 - FULL RELEASE!
notes.content:
Pongaball – Full Release!

Hey everyone,

I'm excited to announce that Pongaball has officially been released in its full version!

This is a big milestone, and I want to thank everyone who’s supported the project so far. That said – I’ll be honest – I’m not 100% satisfied with the current state of the game. There are still things I want to improve, tweak, and expand in future updates. This release isn’t the end – it’s just the beginning.

More updates are planned, and I’ll be working on improving the gameplay, balancing, and overall polish over time. Your feedback means a lot, and I really appreciate everyone who's played, tested, or shared their thoughts.

If you find any bugs or issues, please let me know – either on the Steam discussion board or on our Discord server. It helps a lot!

Thanks again – and stay tuned for what’s next.

notes.title: PongBall Update Status & Development News
notes.content:
Hello PongBall Players,

Work on the next update for PongBall is underway, and we're excited about the new features and improvements coming your way! This update will include:

[b]New Flag Designs[/b]: Fresh visuals for the flags.
[b]New Music[/b]: Added background tracks to enhance the atmosphere.
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Squashing those annoying bugs for a smoother experience.
[b]New Random Events[/b]: Introducing more unpredictable fun during gameplay.
[b]New Game Event Icons[/b]: Updated icons for better clarity.
However, I also need to be transparent about the development timeline. Recently, I've been struggling with motivation regarding the project. Coupled with the fact that my regular job has been demanding more of my time, I have significantly less time and energy to dedicate to the game right now.

Because of these factors, the release of the update will unfortunately be delayed. I currently anticipate this delay could be up to one month longer than originally planned.

I sincerely apologize for this setback and any disappointment it may cause. Your patience and understanding mean a lot during this time. I am still committed to finishing and releasing this update, packed with the features listed above, as soon as I can get back on track.

notes.title: 0.14.0.1 - Linux and macOS
notes.content:
[b]0.14.0.1[/b]
Get ready for another exciting update to PongBall with brand-new features, important fixes, and expanded compatibility!

[b]New Features & Updates[/b]
[i]macOS & Linux Support:[/i] PongBall is now officially supported on macOS and Linux! Play the game seamlessly across these platforms and join the action no matter what system you're on.
[i]Arena Name in Loading Screen[/i]: We've added a new panel during loading screens to display the arena name, giving you a better sense of where the next match is taking place.
[i]New Flag Added[/i]: You can now proudly display the flag of Malaysia in your profile, further expanding our list of international flags.
[b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[i]Text Fixes (key_home)[/i]: Resolved text display issues with the key_home, ensuring smoother and more intuitive gameplay.
[i]Darker Pause Screen[/i]: We’ve adjusted the brightness of the pause screen, making it darker to help you focus better when the game is paused.

This update brings improved functionality and gameplay enhancements, plus a wider reach for our community on macOS and Linux. Download the latest version and experience PongBall like never before!

notes.title: 0.14.0.0 - XP and LEVELS
notes.content:
Hello Pongers! Today we have big update! Check this out..

[b]New Features[/b]

XP Level System: Introducing a new XP level system to track your progress.

Level Up Rewards: Earn exciting rewards each time you level up.

Winning XP: Gain XP for each match you win.

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
Locked Content:

Certain enemies have been locked and require specific levels to unlock.

Some game modes are now locked and require specific levels to unlock.

The red skin is now locked and can be unlocked as you progress. (Lvl 2)

[b]UI Updates[/b]

Updated UI: The user interface now displays your XP, making it easier to track your progress and 
achievements.

F Button on Controllers: Added F button functionality to controllers for smoother gameplay. (PRESS Y or TRIANGLE)

[b]Fixes[/b]

Tutorial Fix: Corrected the first text in the tutorial for better clarity.

Level Up Fix: Leveling up should now work correctly without any issues.

[b]New Achievements[/b]
7 New Achievements: Added seven new achievements for you to unlock and complete.

Experience these exciting new features and improvements in PongBall. Level up, unlock new content, and enjoy a smoother, more rewarding gameplay experience!

notes.title: 0.13.2.0 - Mini event update
notes.content:
Hello Pongers! Get ready for an exciting new update to PongBall! We've packed in fresh features, more customization options, and crucial fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can expect in version 0.13.2.0:

[b]Update 0.13.2.0[/b]
[b]GamePlay[/b]
New Mini Event: Introducing the Faceoff mini event in Ice Hockey mode! Press F faster than your opponent to gain control of the puck.
[b]Flags[/b]
New Flags Added: Players can now represent even more countries with the addition of flags from Kazakhstan, Spain, India, Sweden, Turkey, New Zealand, and France.
[b]Changes[/b]
Arena Renaming: The Retro arena has been renamed to Classic.
[b]Fixes[/b]
Achievement Fixes:
Resolved an issue where goals were not counted towards the "100 Goals" achievement.
Fixed the "Buy Skin" achievement not being awarded correctly.
Campaign Fixes:
Corrected the enemy names in the Campaign mode.
AI Improvements:
Adjusted the speed of AIs for a more balanced gameplay experience.

If you find any bug please report it here on Steam or on our Discord Server!
